epistemic_notice: Records in this file document source, synthetic-SQL, and mocked-boundary evidence at the recorded commits. They do not certify live Supabase Auth/Storage/mailbox containers or production deployment.

findings.title: Historical Supabase service-role credential exposure in reachable Git history
findings.hypothesis: A privileged service-role key committed in historical Git blobs can bypass RLS if still active on the hosted Supabase project.
findings.reproduction: Historical blob inspection documented in docs/security/SECURITY_AUDIT.md without printing or testing secret values.
findings.positive_control: Local tests use synthetic service-role keys only; scripts/provision-local-fixtures.mjs rejects non-loopback targets.
findings.negative_control: src/app/api/internal/test-readiness/route.ts returns 404 if NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL or ELASTICSEARCH_URL is non-loopback.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Requires owner-executed key rotation, server secret replacement, and provider access-log review outside this repository.

status_history.note: Identified in reachable Git history.
Tracked as owner-controlled provider containment gate.

findings.title: Privileged usage RPC accepted arbitrary target users and signed increments
findings.hypothesis: Ordinary authenticated users could execute increment_subscription_usage with negative deltas or foreign user IDs.
findings.reproduction: Execute increment_subscription_usage as role authenticated in tests/database.test.mjs.
findings.positive_control: service_role reserve_operation and finish_operation atomically manage private.operation_reservations.
findings.negative_control: revoke execute on function public.increment_subscription_usage from public, anon, authenticated; verified in tests/database.test.mjs.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Requires applying ordered stabilization migrations to hosted Postgres.

status_history.note: Migration granted SECURITY DEFINER mutator without caller checks.
Execution revoked from ordinary roles; replaced by service-only reserve_operation.

findings.title: Admin demotion and database failure did not reliably revoke export or staff access
findings.hypothesis: Email allowlists, JWT metadata, or stale admin_users rows could grant staff access after user_roles demotion or DB failure.
findings.reproduction: ADMIN-01, ADMIN-02, ADMIN-03 in docs/security/security-boundary-tests.mjs and tests/auth-guards.test.ts.
findings.positive_control: Active user with user_roles role in ('admin', 'owner') succeeds; sensitive actions require AAL2 MFA.
findings.negative_control: Demoted, suspended, or DB-erroring admin requests fail closed with 403/503 before service-role queries or export release.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Requires owner preflight and 20261017120100_stabilization_authorization.sql on hosted Postgres.

status_history.note: Fallback to ADMIN_EMAILS and app_metadata on RPC error.
Canonical user_roles + active profile + MFA step-up enforced.

findings.title: Expensive AI operations lacked authoritative quotas and distributed abuse limits
findings.hypothesis: Process-local demo counters and fail-open quota checks allowed unbounded paid Gemini calls.
findings.reproduction: QUOTA-01 and COST-01 in docs/security/security-boundary-tests.mjs; tests/provider-operations.test.ts.
findings.positive_control: Authorized active user within plan limits reserves and finalizes provider operation.
findings.negative_control: Exhausted budget, replayed operation ID, or unavailable DB throws 429/409/503 before any provider call.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Provider spend caps and billing alerts remain separate operational controls.

status_history.note: checkQuota failed open and demo limiter trusted X-Forwarded-For in memory.
Atomic DB reservations and distributed demo budget implemented.

findings.title: Upload and reprocessing boundaries permitted uncontrolled parser and embedding work
findings.hypothesis: Direct storage registration, spoofed MIME types, ZIP bombs, or concurrent reprocess calls could exhaust memory or paid embeddings.
findings.reproduction: UPLOAD-01 in docs/security/security-boundary-tests.mjs; tests/security-parser-worker.test.ts; tests/security-ingestion.test.ts.
findings.positive_control: Valid owned<=20MiB PDF/DOCX/PPTX/TXT/image processes within worker limits and caches artifacts.
findings.negative_control: JSON registration at /api/materials returns 415; ZIP traversal/expansion bombs, HTML-as-TXT, and concurrent claims fail before embedding.

status_history.note: Unbounded body/archive parsing and unverified storage path registration.
Bounded stream reader, magic-byte checks, isolated worker, and DB processing claims.

findings.title: Child writes were not consistently tied to an owned parent resource
findings.hypothesis: Child rows or note projections could be inserted referencing another user's session, course, or material UUID.
findings.reproduction: BOLA-01 and BOLA-02 in docs/security/security-boundary-tests.mjs; tests/chat-references-boundary.test.ts; tests/database.test.mjs.
findings.positive_control: Owner writes to owned session/course/material succeed.
findings.negative_control: Foreign parent UUIDs are rejected before side effects in API routes and by stabilization_parent_owner triggers + restrictive RLS.

status_history.note: PATCH notes upserted into notes table before checking study_sessions ownership.
Transactional save_session_notes and parent validation triggers enforced.

findings.title: Protected profile moderation and plan columns were writable by ordinary profile update policies
findings.hypothesis: An authenticated user could update their own profile row to clear is_suspended/is_deleted or escalate role/plan.
findings.reproduction: Ordinary role UPDATE on profiles.plan / is_suspended in tests/database.test.mjs.
findings.positive_control: Learner can update allowed academic/preference fields via updateAccountProfile.
findings.negative_control: private.protect_profile_fields() trigger blocks changes to is_suspended, is_deleted, role, plan, email, admin_notes without AAL2 admin.

status_history.note: profiles_update_own allowed updating all columns on own row.
Protected column trigger + strict allowlist in accountProfileUpdate.

findings.title: Auth callback trusted unvalidated next return URLs and mixed origins
findings.hypothesis: An attacker-supplied next parameter on /auth/callback could redirect post-login users to an external domain.
findings.reproduction: OAUTH-01 and OAUTH-03 in docs/security/security-boundary-tests.mjs; tests/auth-callback.test.ts.
findings.positive_control: Relative local paths (/study?fixture=1) redirect on the verified request origin.
findings.negative_control: External URLs, protocol-relative //, and backslash paths fall back to /chat.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Supabase dashboard Redirect URLs must also restrict allowed origins.

status_history.note: sanitizeAuthReturnPath existed but was not called in /auth/callback.
Enforced sanitizeAuthReturnPath and getAuthRequestOrigin in /auth/callback.

findings.title: Auth callback logged raw authorization codes and provider error strings
findings.hypothesis: Logging full callback URLs or PKCE codes in server logs could leak sensitive auth artifacts.
findings.reproduction: OAUTH-02 in docs/security/security-boundary-tests.mjs; tests/auth-callback.test.ts.
findings.positive_control: Callback logs only opaque requestId and fixed status code.
findings.negative_control: Authorization code and error_description markers never appear in console output or redirect locations.

status_history.note: Callback logged full URL and query params.
Redacted callback logging and added Referrer-Policy: no-referrer.

findings.title: Support ticket replies and broadcasts lacked strict sender and audience isolation
findings.hypothesis: A learner could forge sender user_id on support_ticket_replies or read unpublished draft/targeted broadcasts.
findings.reproduction: tests/auth-broadcasts.test.ts and tests/database.test.mjs reply sender/broadcast visibility controls.
findings.positive_control: Ticket owner and admin can reply with their own auth.uid(); learners see only published broadcasts matching their audience.
findings.negative_control: stabilization_reply_sender restrictive RLS blocks forged user_id; stabilization_broadcast_read hides drafts and mismatched audiences.

status_history.note: broadcasts_select_all used true; replies_insert_own did not check user_id = auth.uid().
Enforced sender binding and audience/schedule filtering in API and SQL.

findings.title: Public telemetry tables accepted unauthenticated/ordinary inserts and fabricated KPI success
findings.hypothesis: Public insert policies on telemetry tables allowed forged events and conflated simulated/failed AI calls with live success.
findings.reproduction: tests/activity.test.mjs and tests/database.test.mjs event forgery and BI outcome controls.
findings.positive_control: Server/database producers write v1 events via private.append_event; browser ingestion accepts only bounded page.viewed and study_session.opened.
findings.negative_control: Direct INSERT into public.events or public.ai_requests by anon/authenticated is denied.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Requires private.activity_runtime row configured per environment.

status_history.note: Public insert policies on telemetry tables and hardcoded BI revenue/success.
Revoked direct telemetry writes; implemented v1 activity contract and truthful BI outcomes.

findings.title: Material deletion could succeed while searchable text remained retrievable on dependency failure
findings.hypothesis: Swallowed Elastic delete errors and empty documentIds fallback allowed deleted materials to enter RAG prompts.
findings.reproduction: DELETE-01, RAG-01, RAG-02 in docs/security/security-boundary-tests.mjs; tests/security-rag.test.ts.
findings.positive_control: Active ready owned materials are retrieved and reverified in SQL after search.
findings.negative_control: Tombstoned materials are excluded before and after vector search; failed storage/index cleanup returns 202 and stays queued in private.material_cleanup_jobs.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Requires scheduled execution of lease_material_cleanup_jobs in production.

status_history.note: deleteMaterialFromElastic swallowed errors after 3 retries and documentIds=[] fell back to all user docs.
Atomic SQL tombstone + revisioned cleanup queue + post-search SQL revalidation.

findings.title: Saved quiz scores and answers were trusted from client input without validation or source labeling
findings.hypothesis: Clients could submit impossible scores (e.g. 999) or mutate quiz records directly via Data API.
findings.reproduction: QUIZ-01 in docs/security/security-boundary-tests.mjs; tests/security-practice.test.ts; tests/database.test.mjs.
findings.positive_control: Consistent practice submissions save atomically via save_practice_quiz with result_source='client_reported_practice'.
findings.negative_control: Inconsistent scores/answers fail in both Zod validation and save_practice_quiz SQL; direct INSERT/UPDATE on quizzes/quiz_questions is revoked.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Practice results remain labeled client_reported_practice until server-graded assessments are introduced.

status_history.note: Forged score=999 accepted in POST /api/quiz.
Strict score/answer consistency check + transactional save_practice_quiz + explicit self-reported labeling.

findings.title: Unauthenticated email-existence endpoint and recovery route disclosed account membership
findings.hypothesis: Unauthenticated callers could enumerate registered learner email addresses via /api/auth/check-email or recovery responses.
findings.reproduction: tests/auth-recovery-proof.test.mjs non-disclosure and rate-limit controls.
findings.positive_control: /api/auth/check-email and /api/auth/recovery return uniform non-disclosing responses.
findings.negative_control: Rate-limited or non-existent emails receive the identical generic recovery message without revealing account existence.

status_history.note: check-email queried profiles with service-role client and returned exists boolean.
Removed DB lookup in check-email and enforced non-disclosing recovery intent flow.

findings.title: Administrative actions returned success without a durable, verified audit record
findings.hypothesis: Unchecked client-role audit_logs inserts silently failed while sensitive mutations committed.
findings.reproduction: tests/database.test.mjs trigger rollback controls when private.activity_runtime is deleted; tests/admin-ticket-audit-boundary.test.ts.
findings.positive_control: Database triggers write v1 security/admin events in the same transaction as role, profile, setting, ticket, broadcast, coupon, and institution mutations.
findings.negative_control: When private.activity_runtime is unavailable, the entire sensitive mutation rolls back.

status_history.note: Authenticated client inserts to audit_logs failed RLS silently.
Transactional DB audit triggers and fail-closed event writer enforced.

findings.title: Outdated Next.js 16.2.6 / KaTeX dependencies and broken lint/typecheck/build baseline
findings.hypothesis: Next 16.2.6 and older KaTeX had published security advisories, and missing React Query / ESLint 9 config prevented verification builds.
findings.reproduction: npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run build, and npm audit.
findings.positive_control: Next and eslint-config-next pinned to 16.4.1, KaTeX pinned to 0.19.0, local fonts bundled, and parser runtime closure traced.
findings.negative_control: Strict ESLint and TypeScript checks run without rule waivers.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Periodic advisory checks remain required before every release.

status_history.note: Next 16.2.6 advisory match and failing build/lint/typecheck.
Upgraded to Next 16.4.1 and KaTeX 0.19.0; restored strict checks.

findings.title: Missing table privileges and RLS policies on feedback, broadcasts, coupon_codes, and institutions broke learner own-feedback reads and admin mutations
findings.hypothesis: Historical migrations omitted feedback_select_own, feedback_admin_update, and authenticated INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE grants on broadcasts, coupon_codes, and institutions.
findings.reproduction: Execute learner feedback SELECT and admin feedback/broadcast/coupon/institution mutations in tests/database.test.mjs.
findings.positive_control: Learners read own feedback; admins update feedback and create broadcasts; AAL2 admins manage coupons and institutions.
findings.negative_control: Learner B cannot read Learner A feedback; non-admins cannot update feedback or create broadcasts; AAL1 admins are denied coupon/institution mutations.

status_history.note: Added missing policies and privileges in 20261029120000_stabilization_audit_repairs.sql.

findings.title: Historical SECURITY DEFINER admin RPCs lacked entry-level AAL2 MFA enforcement, target existence checks, and emitted legacy v0 events
findings.hypothesis: Calling legacy admin RPCs directly via Data API with a no-op state or missing target bypassed BEFORE UPDATE profile triggers and AAL2 MFA, and admin_toggle_soft_delete inserted schema_version=0 rows into public.events.
findings.reproduction: Invoke admin_toggle_suspension, admin_toggle_soft_delete, admin_delete_user, and admin_assign_plan as AAL1 admin in tests/database.test.mjs.
findings.positive_control: AAL2 admin mutates existing non-final-owner target and records v1 event + audit_logs row.
findings.negative_control: AAL1 admin, missing target UUID, invalid plan/status, or final-owner disablement is rejected; zero schema_version=0 rows are added.

status_history.note: Hardened all four RPCs with entry-level require_sensitive_admin(), target/input validation, and v1-only event auditing.

findings.title: Unchecked legacy audit_logs inserts and broadcast title content leakage in API routes
findings.hypothesis: Routes attempted authenticated-client inserts into public.audit_logs (which has no INSERT policy/grant) and copied broadcast title content.
findings.reproduction: tests/active-api-routes.test.ts broadcast audit boundary test.
findings.positive_control: Database triggers stabilization_staff_audit and stabilization_coupon_audit record content-free v1 events transactionally.
findings.negative_control: Routes no longer call supabase.from('audit_logs').insert(...) or copy broadcast titles.

status_history.note: Removed redundant/denied client audit_logs inserts from ticket, broadcast, and coupon routes.

findings.title: Profile update trigger recorded full-name PII in audit_logs and hard deletion left target UUIDs in audit_logs
findings.hypothesis: tr_log_profile_update copied old_name/new_name into audit_logs.details, and deleting auth.users left target_user_id in audit_logs.details.
findings.reproduction: tests/database.test.mjs profile update PII and hard user deletion audit_logs control.
findings.positive_control: Staff user_id and action remain on audit_logs after target deletion.
findings.negative_control: old_name, new_name, and deleted target_user_id are absent from public.audit_logs.

status_history.note: Sanitized log_profile_update and extended pseudonymize_deleted_actor to scrub audit_logs.details.

findings.title: Missing v1 activity event producers for material upload lifecycle and completed password recovery
findings.hypothesis: material.upload.started/completed/failed and auth.recovery.completed were declared in contracts.ts and private.append_event but not emitted by operation/recovery RPCs.
findings.reproduction: tests/database.test.mjs upload reservation and recovery proof consumption lifecycle event control.
findings.positive_control: Upload reservation/settlement and recovery proof consumption atomically append deduplicated v1 events.
findings.negative_control: Unconsumed or expired recovery proofs emit no completion event.

status_history.note: Wired v1 upload and recovery completion events in SQL RPCs.

findings.title: Admin API routes leaked raw error strings, lacked bounded JSON/pagination checks and no-store headers, and privacy policy had stale canonical URL
findings.hypothesis: Admin endpoints returned String(err) / error.message on failures, omitted Cache-Control: private, no-store, and /privacy-policy used https://learn.app/privacy-policy.
findings.reproduction: Inspect route error handlers and tests/active-api-routes.test.ts.
findings.positive_control: Valid admin requests succeed with Cache-Control: private, no-store; /privacy-policy canonical is https://www.uselerna.app/privacy-policy.
findings.negative_control: Invalid UUIDs, oversized bodies, and backend errors return sanitized messages with 400/503 status.

status_history.note: Sanitized admin error responses, added bounded input/pagination validation and no-store headers, and fixed privacy canonical URL.

findings.title: Historical VM security boundary and parser test harnesses failed on refactored first-party module imports and worker threads
findings.hypothesis: The 12 October VM runners threw 13 harness errors because their require whitelist did not resolve refactored first-party @/ modules or node:worker_threads.
findings.reproduction: Run node docs/security/security-boundary-tests.mjs --secure and node docs/security/parser-render-tests.mjs.
findings.positive_control: All 16 secure boundary assertions and all 4 parser + 3 markdown render checks pass offline with zero provider calls.
findings.negative_control: External/provider imports remain blocked unless explicitly mocked.

status_history.note: Replay produced 3 pass / 13 harness errors due to revised module boundaries.
Repaired VM module resolution and UUID/precondition fixtures without weakening any assertion (16/16 pass).

findings.title: Transitive dev-only braces ReDoS advisory (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) in ESLint/Tailwind glob tooling
findings.hypothesis: Unpatched braces 3.0.3 in dev-only ESLint/Tailwind micromatch chain is flagged by npm audit (7 high entries).
findings.reproduction: Run npm audit --json.
findings.positive_control: npm audit --omit=dev excludes all 7 braces entries; braces is not bundled in runtime server or browser code.
findings.negative_control: No untrusted user input reaches build-time ESLint/Tailwind glob patterns.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Re-evaluate when upstream ESLint/Tailwind/micromatch releases a non-breaking patched braces dependency.

status_history.note: Assessed unreachable in production runtime (--omit=dev).

findings.title: Transitive sprintf-js / argparse advisory (GHSA-hp3w-g68c-fv3c) in Mammoth unused CLI chain
findings.hypothesis: Mammoth 1.12.0 declares argparse -> sprintf-js for its CLI binary, producing 3 moderate npm audit entries.
findings.reproduction: Run npm audit --omit=dev --json.
findings.positive_control: parser-worker.cjs invokes mammoth.extractRawText({ buffer }) programmatically in an isolated worker after ZIP validation; Mammoth's lib/index.js never imports argparse or sprintf-js.
findings.negative_control: No CLI argument parsing or sprintf-js formatting is reachable from document uploads.
findings.dependency_config_assumptions: Monitor Mammoth releases for removal or upgrade of argparse.

status_history.note: Verified unreachable in programmatic mammoth.extractRawText path.

findings.title: Split quiz quota and double charge on quiz question generation and practice completion
findings.hypothesis: Charging both quiz question generation and practice result saving against the quizzes allowance blocked saving the final allowed quiz.
findings.reproduction: tests/quiz-generation-budget.test.ts and tests/database.test.mjs one-slot quiz generation + save control.
findings.positive_control: One remaining quiz slot allows generating questions (charged to aiRequests) and saving the completed practice quiz (charged to quizzes).
findings.negative_control: A subsequent practice save beyond the quiz limit is rejected with PT429.

status_history.note: Separated AI generation budget from practice completion receipts; re-reviewed.

findings.title: Invalid or foreign chat references created orphan study sessions before parent validation
findings.hypothesis: Supplying a malformed or foreign sessionId, courseId, or materialId in POST /api/chat could create a new session or invoke Gemini before failing.
findings.reproduction: tests/chat-boundary.test.ts foreign session/course/deleted material controls.
findings.positive_control: Valid owned session/course/material proceeds to tutoring response.
findings.negative_control: Malformed, foreign, or deleted IDs return 400/404 before any session insert, message insert, or provider call.

status_history.note: Validated UUID syntax and owned parents before session creation or provider calls; re-reviewed.

findings.title: Long-running paged exports lacked a final authorization and MFA recheck before data release
findings.hypothesis: An admin demoted or suspended while a multi-page export was being collected could still receive the exported dataset.
findings.reproduction: tests/admin-export-boundary.test.ts and tests/activity-export-boundary.test.ts mid-export demotion controls.
findings.positive_control: Active AAL2 admin whose identity remains valid before release receives audited export.
findings.negative_control: Demotion or identity change before release returns 403 and withholds all rows without writing a false export success audit.

status_history.note: Added post-collection requireAdminApi({ requireMfa: true }) recheck before audit and response release.

findings.title: Denied anonymous demo requests incremented the daily counter and exhausted daily allowance
findings.hypothesis: Incrementing demo_budget before checking both minute (10) and day (100) caps caused minute-rate-limited requests to burn the daily demo budget.
findings.reproduction: tests/database.test.mjs denied demo request control.
findings.positive_control: Up to 10 requests per minute and 100 per UTC day are accepted.
findings.negative_control: Minute-denied requests do not increment private.demo_budget.

status_history.note: Checked both day and minute counts under advisory lock before incrementing demo_budget.

findings.title: Legacy ticket update audit copied private resolution_notes content
findings.hypothesis: PUT /api/admin/tickets copied resolution_notes into a separate legacy audit_logs insert.
findings.reproduction: tests/admin-ticket-audit-boundary.test.ts.
findings.positive_control: Ticket updates commit with transactional content-free v1 event from stabilization_staff_audit.
findings.negative_control: No resolution_notes text is written to audit_logs or events.properties.

status_history.note: Removed content-bearing legacy audit insert in PUT /api/admin/tickets.

findings.title: Administrative usage reset lacked transactional audit and needed explicit legacy-counter scope
findings.hypothesis: Resetting subscription_usage directly in route handlers was non-transactional with audit logging and could be mistaken for durable quota replenishment.
findings.reproduction: tests/database.test.mjs admin_reset_usage and admin_extend_subscription rollback and budget-snapshot preservation controls.
findings.positive_control: AAL2 admin resets legacy daily cache in one transaction with audit_logs and v1 event while durable reservation usage stays intact.
findings.negative_control: AAL1 admin or audit-outage attempt rolls back.

status_history.note: Implemented transactional admin_reset_usage and admin_extend_subscription RPCs.

findings.title: Failed recovery browser proof forwarded newly exchanged Auth session cookies
findings.hypothesis: If PKCE code exchange succeeded in /auth/callback but grantRecoveryProof failed (e.g. different browser), forwarding response cookies would sign the browser in without recovery proof.
findings.reproduction: tests/auth-callback.test.ts and tests/auth-recovery-proof.test.mjs positive-cookie suppression controls.
findings.positive_control: Valid browser + nonce + email + session receives lerna-recovery-proof cookie.
findings.negative_control: Failure responses in /auth/callback and finishRecovery forward only cookie removals (empty value or maxAge <= 0).

status_history.note: Filtered failure cookies to retain only explicit removals; re-reviewed.

findings.title: Deleted actor remained identifiable through event dedup_key and legacy v0 properties
findings.hypothesis: Nulling events.user_id on auth.users deletion left the user UUID embedded inside dedup_key or v0 properties.
findings.reproduction: tests/database.test.mjs hard deletion pseudonymization control.
findings.positive_control: Unrelated staff user_id on administrative actions is preserved.
findings.negative_control: Deleted user UUID is cleared from user_id, resource_id, dedup_key, v0 properties, and audit_logs.

status_history.note: Cleared dedup_key and v0 properties on actor deletion; extended to audit_logs in 20261029120000.

findings.title: Pre-read activity investigation audit claimed succeeded outcome before querying source
findings.hypothesis: Recording admin.activity.read as succeeded before executing the source query misrepresented failed source reads as succeeded.
findings.reproduction: tests/activity-read-outcome.test.ts failed-source controls.
findings.positive_control: Pre-read audit event uses outcome='attempted' and fails closed if event storage is unavailable.
findings.negative_control: Source query failure returns 503 while leaving only the attempted read record.

status_history.note: Changed pre-read audit outcome to attempted; re-reviewed.
